resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the one combined City of Wildwood Application for Transfer of Ownership (property, units, bedrooms, seasonal or year-round, settlement date, owner, buyer, agent) and turn it in with payment at City Hall, 4400 New Jersey Avenue. No application is accepted without payment; do not fax or mail it without payment. The current fire form says separate checks are required for the fire, CCO and zoning certificates. Reports are faxed or emailed when done.

resale_co.notes: Wildwood requires a Continued Occupancy (CCO) inspection and a Zoning certification on a transfer of ownership, applied for on one combined form posted on the Code Enforcement page. The combined form dates from January 2018, and its smoke certificate fees ($45/$90/$161) have since been replaced by the Fire Prevention Bureau's January 2026 form (see fire_cert), so the CCO and zoning fees may also have changed; confirm before quoting. The form's two pages differ on large buildings (page 1 says over 10 units add $10.00 per unit, page 2 says over 5 units); this does not affect 1-2 family homes. The form gives Kate Dunn's email as kdunn@wildwoodnj.org; the current Construction page lists kdunn@wildwoodnj.gov. Zoning Officer: Steven Booy, 609-522-2444 ext. 2240, sbooy@wildwoodnj.org (Planning & Zoning page). The City's Construction Department also serves West Wildwood Borough. Wildwood also requires vacant property registration ($500), which is not a sale requirement.

requirements: On-site inspection by the Wildwood Fire Prevention Bureau; do not apply until everything is in place
Smoke alarms in each sleeping room (City ordinance), outside (within 10 feet of) each sleeping area, and on every level
Hardwired smoke alarms must be replaced if more than 10 years past the manufacture date; battery smoke alarms must be sealed battery type
CO alarms outside (within 10 feet of) each sleeping area and on every level when there are fuel-burning appliances or an attached garage

Homes with a generator, solar panels, battery storage or other secondary power source need a printed label reading 'CAUTION: MULTIPLE SOURCES OF POWER.' within 18 inches of the main electrical panel and the electric meter (handwritten labels not accepted)
The January 2026 form does not list a fire extinguisher
Any outstanding fees on the property must be settled before the inspection

authorities.how_to_apply: Fill out the Application for a Certificate of Smoke Alarm and Carbon Monoxide Alarm Compliance (CSACMAC) for 1 or 2 family dwellings and submit it with payment (separate check from the CCO and zoning fees) to the Fire Prevention Bureau, 4400 New Jersey Avenue, Wildwood, NJ 08260, fax 609-522-4965 or email fireprev@wildwoodnj.gov. Credit cards are accepted with a 3% surcharge. The inspection is scheduled once the application is received; a failed inspection needs a re-inspection with a re-inspection fee (amount not stated).
